craftinginfo-guide-text: VS Roofing Mod: Crafting Guide Roofs are crafted in world by first constructing the frame and then adding roofing material(s) to it. Frames Frame Types Stick / Bamboo / Branch These early game frames are constructed from sticks, bamboo-stakes and firewood(branch)stick|bamboostakes|firewood while holding twine/rope resources (Flax fibers, Cattails, Papyrus and Wildvines) flaxfibers|cattailtops|papyrustops/wildvine-section-north in your off hand. Timber This late(er) game frame is constructed from boards plank-birch|plank-oak|plank-maple|plank-pine|plank-acacia|plank-kapok|plank-baldcypress|plank-larch|plank-redwood|plank-ebony|plank-walnut|plank-purpleheart|plank-aged while holding a hammer hammer-copper|hammer-tinbronze|hammer-bismuthbronze|hammer-blackbronze|hammer-gold|hammer-silver|hammer-iron|hammer-meteoriciron|hammer-steel in your off hand. Metal This late game frame is constructed from metal rods rod-copper|rod-tinbronze|rod-bismuthbronze|rod-blackbronze|rod-gold|rod-silver|rod-iron|rod-meteoriciron|rod-steel|rod-cupronickel|rod-electrum while holding a hammer hammer-copper|hammer-tinbronze|hammer-bismuthbronze|hammer-blackbronze|hammer-gold|hammer-silver|hammer-iron|hammer-meteoriciron|hammer-steel in your off hand. Construct each frame with rightmouse button. Frames can be placed horizontally and vertically to create low and high slopes. Corners (outer and inner) are created by combinations of perpendicular roofs placed in front or behind each other. You can also select the frame type (Standard, Eave, Ridge) using toolmodeselect (ToolModes). This menu will also give you access to Left/Right variants as well as the ability to manually override the slope and placement. Materials To add roofing materials, hold the required item/block and press the rightmouse button while holding shift on the frame. Some materials may require a tool in the off hand to be added. Some roofing recipes may also require additional resources in your inventory. See Recipe Guide for more info. Base block To add the base(fill) block hold the desired block and press the rightmouse button while holding ctrl. These base blocks can be chiseled. Tip: You can rotate the textures with the wrench. You can also add more materials using ctrl. Locking You can lock a block using the hammer + rightmouse to toggle the lock. This will prevent any reconfiguration. Hide Beams You can also hide beams using the saw + rightmouse. This will toggle the beam between Hidden and Auto (i.e. you cannot add beams. Tip: Not all beams belong to all blocks, try the neighbouring block if its not working.
